about.title: Welcome to WIRELESS
about.callout: Your trusted destination for mobiles, second hand phones, accessories, lamination and expert repairs. Genuine products, honest service and the latest accessories — all under one roof at WIRELESS.
about.story: Located on Post Office Road in Subhash Nagar, Dehradun, WIRELESS is your trusted destination for all mobile phone needs. From expert phone repairs and premium lamination to genuine accessories, stylish skins & wraps, new phones, and verified second-hand devices — we offer it all under one roof with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

ENGLISH: Had an amazing experience at WIRELESS! The repair quality was outstanding, the staff was super helpful, and prices were very fair. Highly recommended for any mobile phone needs!
One of the best cell phone stores in Dehradun! Got my phone screen replaced and it looks brand new. They also have a fantastic collection of skins and accessories. Definitely coming back!
Loved everything about WIRELESS! Great range of phones and accessories, expert repair service, and the lamination work was flawless. 5 stars all the way!
HINGLISH: WIRELESS ka experience bohot hi shaandaar tha! Phone repair ekdum professional tha, staff bohot helpful tha aur prices bhi reasonable. Definitely recommended for all mobile needs!
Bohot hi mast phone store hai! Screen replacement karwaya aur bilkul new jaisa lag raha hai. Skins aur wraps ka collection bhi zabardast hai. Zaroor visit karo!
Inka repair work aur service dono lajawab the! Super value for money aur genuine accessories milte hain. 5 stars!
HINDI: WIRELESS में बहुत ही शानदार अनुभव रहा! फोन रिपेयर बिल्कुल प्रोफेशनल था और स्टाफ़ का व्यवहार भी बहुत विनम्र था। मोबाइल से जुड़ी किसी भी ज़रूरत के लिए ज़रूर आएं!
यहाँ की सर्विस और प्रोडक्ट रेंज दोनों ही लाजवाब हैं! स्क्रीन बदलवाई और बिल्कुल नए जैसी लग रही है। 5 स्टार अनुभव!
फोन रिपेयर, लैमिनेशन और एक्सेसरीज़ के लिए बेहतरीन जगह। कीमत भी उचित और काम भी बढ़िया।
